About Shahnawaz Ahmed

Founder of MarketingX — Digital Solutions & Business Growth. Helping businesses build stronger digital presences with websites, eCommerce, apps, SEO and advertising.

I'm Shahnawaz Ahmed — I plan it, I build it, I support it

I founded MarketingX on a simple belief: good digital work should be both beautifully designed and commercially effective. When you work with MarketingX, you work directly with me — no hand-offs, no account managers — so the person who plans your project is the person who builds it, and the person you can call after it launches.

My work spans Shopify and WordPress development, custom and AI-assisted websites, web and mobile apps, technical and local SEO, and paid advertising across Meta, Google and TikTok. That breadth matters: your website, your search visibility and your ads should all pull in the same direction, and I build them that way.

I take on projects I can personally stand behind. If something won't help your business, I'll tell you — and if I recommend it, it's because it serves a goal we agreed together.

  • Quality first — tested, polished work on every delivery
  • Honest scope & pricing — clear quotations before we start
  • Clear communication — direct updates at every stage of your project
  • Long-term support — maintenance, optimisation and growth after launch

My working approach

Every project starts with discovery — your goals, your customers, your competitors. From there I agree a written scope, timeline and quotation before any build work begins, keep you updated at each milestone, and test everything across devices before launch. You approve each stage, so there are no surprises at the end.

My principles

  • Quality over shortcuts — if it isn't tested, it isn't finished
  • Plain-English communication — no jargon, no silence
  • Honest advice — including when the answer is "you don't need that"
  • Support after launch — your project keeps improving, not ageing

                Home / Privacy Policy

                Privacy Policy

                Last updated: November 2026

                Information we collect

                When you contact MarketingX — by form, email, phone or WhatsApp — we receive the details you provide, such as your name, email address, business name, website URL and project information. This website's forms open your own email application; no form data is stored on this website.

                How we use it

                Your information is used only to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotations, deliver services you engage, and provide ongoing support. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

                Communications

                We may contact you about your project or enquiry. Marketing messages are only sent with your consent, and you can opt out at any time by replying to the message.

                Tools & integrations

                This website does not use online booking calendars, analytics trackers or third-party form processors, and it does not set tracking cookies. Contact happens through your own email application, your phone, or WhatsApp — when you use WhatsApp, that conversation is handled under WhatsApp's own privacy policy. If integrations are added in future, this policy will be updated first.

                Your rights

                You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by emailing marketingx.shahnawaz@gmail.com.

                Contact

                MarketingX by Shahnawaz Ahmed · marketingx.shahnawaz@gmail.com · +92 337 5905986

                Home / Terms & Conditions

                Terms & Conditions

                Last updated: November 2026

                Services

                MarketingX provides website, eCommerce and app development, SEO, digital advertising and creative services. The scope, deliverables, timeline and price for each engagement are agreed in a written quotation before work begins.

                Quotations & payment

                Quotations are based on the information provided at the time of enquiry. Work outside the agreed scope is quoted separately. Payment terms are confirmed in your project agreement.

                Revisions & support

                Reasonable revisions within the agreed scope are included as set out in your quotation. Ongoing maintenance and support packages are available after launch.

                Intellectual property

                On full payment, final deliverables transfer to the client as agreed in the project terms. Third-party platforms, themes and tools remain subject to their own licences.

                Website content

                Storefronts, dashboards and scores shown in this website's hero and showcase sections are labelled illustrative UI previews with sample data. They are design examples of work MarketingX can build — not live client data, customer ratings or achieved results.

                Liability

                MarketingX works to professional standards, but results from SEO and advertising depend on market conditions and cannot be guaranteed. Nothing on this website constitutes a guarantee of specific business outcomes.

                Contact

                Questions about these terms: marketingx.shahnawaz@gmail.com
